module "S5_Builder.dss"

product 0 Material "M_S5_Builder" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.4), ParameterName="Rough", SortPriority=1) : float @L6:C1 "Rough"
  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), ParameterName="Albedo", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L5:C1 "Albedo"
  %2 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L5:C1
  %3 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L13:C22
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0.3)) : float @L14:C22
  %5 = Constant(Value=(0.1)) : float @L15:C36
  %6 = Multiply(%2, %5) : float3 @L15:C27
  %7 = Reflected[MetalnessToDiffuseAlbedoF0](BaseColor=%2, Metallic=%3) : [DiffuseAlbedo:float3, F0:float3] @L10:C23 "Paint"
  %8 = Reflected[HazinessToSecondaryRoughness](BaseRoughness=%0, Haziness=%4) : [SecondRoughness:float, SecondRoughnessWeight:float] @L10:C23 "Paint"
  %9 = Reflected[Slab](Roughness=%0, EmissiveColor=%6, DiffuseAlbedo=%7, F0=%7#1, SecondRoughness=%8, SecondRoughnessWeight=%8#1) : Substrate @L10:C23 "Paint"
  %10 = MaterialSink(FrontMaterial=%9) @L8:C1
  sink %10
